title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values from a model. They tell us how far off our predictions are from the actual data points.

title: Average of Residuals
text: The average of the residuals in a well-fitted model is typically zero. This is because the model aims to minimize the sum of squared residuals, balancing positive and negative errors.
